description: PROPOSED (Discussion #49), not yet finalized. verdict: "unverified" with passed: true is rejected (VERDICT_PASSED_MISMATCH): an outcome that could not be judged can never be reported as a pass. "passed" requires passed: true; "failed" and "unverified" require passed: false. Unlike SELF_PARENT or DUPLICATE_ATTEMPT, this cross-field rule is a conditional against a constant, so spec/schemas/resultset.json expresses it directly (allOf with if/then/const): the raw JSON Schema and both hand-rolled validators all reject this document. A conforming validator MUST REJECT it.
